content_sections.heading: MCD Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the MCD Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download MCD Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Resident : MBBS Degree from MCI/NMC Recognized University/Institution, PG degree/DNB/Diploma, or equivalent in concerned Specialty. If adequate candidates as per educational qualifications are not available in particular specialty, then candidates with MBBS Degree with two years of experience, out of which one year should be in concerned specialty, can be considered.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Senior Resident : Maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as follows: SC/ST: 5 years, OBC: 3 years, PwD: 10 years.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MCD Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment drive is conducted by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) for filling up vacant medical positions under its healthcare department on a regular basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for MCD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi is hiring eligible candidates for the post of Senior Resident across specific medical specialties such as Gynaecology and Pathology.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been announced under this recruitment notification, distributed among Gynae and Pathology specialties for eligible medical professionals.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The application and selection process is entirely based on a Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates do not need to submit any online application prior to the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the MCD Senior Resident posts is scheduled to be conducted on 09 October 2026 at the designated municipal hospital venue.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with a PG Degree, DNB, or Diploma in the concerned specialty from an MCI or NMC recognized institution.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years. Upper age relaxations are provided for reserved category candidates in accordance with government guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary according to Pay Matrix Level-11 along with usual allowances admissible under the rules of the organization.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, General, OBC, and EWS candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1000/-, while SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: You can check and download the official notification PDF by visiting the Important Links section of this article and clicking the designated link.
